short_description: Psoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin condition that causes thick, scaly, red patches. It can come and go in flare-ups and may be triggered by stress, infections, cold weather, or skin irritation.
common_symptoms: scaling on elbows, knees, scalp, or body
temporary_advice: Protect skin from dryness and cold weather
Try to identify triggers such as stress or irritation
avoid: Avoid random creams without medical advice
risk_notes: Psoriasis is usually not contagious, but it can become painful, chronic, and may be associated with joint problems in some people.
when_to_see_doctor: If plaques spread or become painful
If skin cracks, bleeds, or shows infection signs
If there is joint pain or swelling
If symptoms keep coming back or worsen
